rajshree-institute-of-management-and-tec.description: Rajshree Institute of Management and Technology is an AKTU-affiliated engineering and management college on the Pilibhit road in Bareilly, part of the Rajshree Group.
rajshree-institute-of-management-and-tec.about: The institute was established in 2009 and received AKTU affiliation the same year. Its institute code is 479 for B.Tech, M.Tech and MBA. The campus is at the 16 km mark of NH-30 on the Pilibhit road.
rajshree-institute-of-management-and-tec.address: 16 KM, NH-30, Pilibhit Road, Bareilly, Uttar Pradesh
rajshree-institute-of-management-and-tec.affiliated_to: Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University, Lucknow

rakshpal-bahadur-college-of-engineering-.description: Rakshpal Bahadur College of Engineering and Technology is part of the RBMI Group of Institutions on Badaun Road in Bareilly.
rakshpal-bahadur-college-of-engineering-.about: RBCET runs B.Tech and engineering diploma courses approved by AICTE. Its B.Tech is affiliated to Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University and its diplomas to the Board of Technical Education, Lucknow. The college states it has offered technical education since 1996.
rakshpal-bahadur-college-of-engineering-.address: Badaun Road, near Doordarshan Kendra and ITBP, Bareilly, Uttar Pradesh
rakshpal-bahadur-college-of-engineering-.affiliated_to: Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University, Lucknow

shri-ram-murti-smarak-college-of-enginee.description: Shri Ram Murti Smarak College of Engineering and Technology is an AKTU-affiliated engineering college run by the SRMS Trust on the Bareilly-Nainital road.
shri-ram-murti-smarak-college-of-enginee.about: SRMS CET was established by the SRMS Trust in 1996. It is approved by AICTE and affiliated to Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University, which has recognised it as a star performer college. Its MBA programme is NBA accredited until 2026-27.
shri-ram-murti-smarak-college-of-enginee.address: Ram Murti Puram, 13 Km Bareilly-Nainital Road, Bhojipura, Bareilly, Uttar Pradesh 243202
shri-ram-murti-smarak-college-of-enginee.affiliated_to: Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University, Lucknow

shri-ram-murti-smarak-college-of-enginee.description: Shri Ram Murti Smarak College of Engineering, Technology and Research is a second SRMS Trust engineering college on the same Bareilly-Nainital road campus.
shri-ram-murti-smarak-college-of-enginee.about: SRMS CETR was founded in 2008 and is managed by the SRMS Trust, Bareilly. It is affiliated to Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University. It shares the Ram Murti Puram campus at Bhojipura.
shri-ram-murti-smarak-college-of-enginee.address: Ram Murti Puram, 13 Km Bareilly-Nainital Road, Bhojipura, Bareilly, Uttar Pradesh 243202
shri-ram-murti-smarak-college-of-enginee.affiliated_to: Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University, Lucknow

shri-siddhi-vinayak-institute-of-technol.description: Shri Siddhi Vinayak Institute of Technology is the engineering college of the Shri Siddhi Vinayak Group of Institutions in Bareilly.
shri-siddhi-vinayak-institute-of-technol.about: SSVIT is part of the Shri Siddhi Vinayak Group of Institutions, which also runs management and polytechnic institutes on a 50 acre campus. The group lists approvals and affiliations from AICTE, AKTU, MJPRU, the technical education board and the state medical faculty.
shri-siddhi-vinayak-institute-of-technol.affiliated_to: Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University, Lucknow

bharat-ratna-sardar-vallabh-bhai-patel-r.description: Bharat Ratna Sardar Vallabh Bhai Patel Rajkiya Engineering College is a Government of Uttar Pradesh engineering college on Bansi Road in Basti, affiliated to AKTU.
bharat-ratna-sardar-vallabh-bhai-patel-r.about: The college was established by the Government of Uttar Pradesh in 2023 as Rajkiya Engineering College, Basti, and was renamed after Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel in 2025. It is affiliated to Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University under college code 1213. It offers B.Tech in electrical, computer science, civil and electronics engineering with 60 seats each.
bharat-ratna-sardar-vallabh-bhai-patel-r.affiliated_to: Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University, Lucknow

k-l-s-institute-of-engineering-and-techn.description: KLS Institute of Engineering and Technology is an engineering college of the Subharti Group at Chandak on the Bijnor-Haridwar road.
k-l-s-institute-of-engineering-and-techn.about: KLSIET is part of the Subharti Group of Institutions. It is affiliated to Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University and approved by AICTE. Its campus is at village Khudaheri near Chandak, on the 20th km of the Bijnor-Haridwar road.
k-l-s-institute-of-engineering-and-techn.address: 20th Km Milestone, Bijnor-Haridwar Road, Village Khudaheri, Chandak, Bijnor, Uttar Pradesh 246721
k-l-s-institute-of-engineering-and-techn.affiliated_to: Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University, Lucknow

kunwar-satyavira-college-of-engineering-.description: Kunwar Satyavira College of Engineering and Management is an AKTU-affiliated engineering college on Barrage Road in Bijnor.
kunwar-satyavira-college-of-engineering-.about: KSVCEM was established in 1999 and holds AKTU college code 017. It is approved by AICTE and affiliated to Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University. It offers engineering branches including biotechnology, civil, mechanical, computer science, electronics and electrical, plus management programmes.
kunwar-satyavira-college-of-engineering-.address: Barrage Road, Opp. New Telephone Exchange, Bijnor, Uttar Pradesh 246701
kunwar-satyavira-college-of-engineering-.affiliated_to: Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University, Lucknow

nigc-institute-of-technology-and-managem.description: NIGC Institute of Technology and Management is part of the North India Group of Colleges on Bundki Road in Najibabad, Bijnor district.
nigc-institute-of-technology-and-managem.about: The institute runs under the Bhagwat Saran Educational Trust. It is approved by AICTE and affiliated to Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University and the Board of Technical Education, Lucknow. It is located on Bundki Road near Najibabad.
nigc-institute-of-technology-and-managem.address: 7 KM Bundki Road, Najibabad, Bijnor, Uttar Pradesh 246763
nigc-institute-of-technology-and-managem.affiliated_to: Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University, Lucknow

r-v-institute-of-technology.description: R V Institute of Technology is an engineering and pharmacy college on the Bijnor-Moradabad road in Bijnor district.
r-v-institute-of-technology.about: RVIT was established in 2009 in memory of Shri Ranveer Singh. It is approved by AICTE and affiliated to Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University and the Board of Technical Education, Lucknow. It offers B.Tech and polytechnic engineering alongside pharmacy courses.
r-v-institute-of-technology.address: Village Alhedadpur, 9th Km Milestone, Bijnor-Moradabad Road, Bijnor, Uttar Pradesh
r-v-institute-of-technology.affiliated_to: Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University, Lucknow
